title: How a Godly Man Grades His Worst Day and Everyone Else's Best One
caption:
How a godly man grades his worst day and everyone else's best one.

Different scale for himself than for the guy next to him.

The comment that landed wrong replays in his head for a week. Yours gets forgotten by lunch. That's not weakness. That's where his growth actually happens.

Waiting for the exact percentage of blame is pride doing math. He goes first. He gives you the excuse he'd never give himself.

Comparing himself to the guy doing worse is how a man stays comfortable. Comparing himself to Christ is how he stays honest.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #humility #grace #discipleship
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
